claim: The pre-change direct R4Server unit probe demonstrated a shared live desktop document.
reason: The pre-change R4Server owned an independent in-memory Scene. Passing direct server tests did not connect it to Builder3dApp, its panels, or undo history.
retained_source: Historical pre-change test record; not used as RB-09 live evidence.

claim: The Release MCP client probe demonstrates a live Rust desktop edit.
decision: rejected for live-edit claim; accepted only for stdio/catalog/closed-desktop behavior
reason: The probe intentionally used an absent runtime descriptor and received desktop_unavailable. No Rust desktop was running.

claim: The RB-08 black diagnostic image can be used as RB-09 native evidence or as RB-08 completion evidence.
reason: The image was captured under the locked Windows session, is already marked diagnostic/rejected in RB-08, and is not an accepted native capture for either slice.
retained_source: evidence/rebuild/rb-08-preferences-and-complete-shell/native/rust-live-final-20261102-101724/; RB-08 remains pending its native matrix and completion snapshot.

claim: cargo bloat --release --workspace proves whole-workspace size coverage.
decision: rejected for workspace-size claim; command exit accepted as a gate record
reason: cargo-bloat 0.12.1 emitted Warning: unused arguments left: ["--workspace"]. The explicit builder3d-app target bloat report is retained separately.

claim: The first Rust MCP New/Open from Welcome showed the active project in the GUI immediately.
decision: rejected as a final pass claim; retained as a pre-repair defect observation
reason: The initial actual MCP call installed/opened the document but the visible shell remained on Welcome. A scoped presentation synchronization repair and two regression tests were added; the repaired sequence then showed Scene and immediate viewport/Items updates.

claim: rust-final-paired-dark-initial.png is a clean Dark scene capture.
reason: The screenshot contains the Settings dialog. Use rust-final-paired-dark-scene.png for the clean Dark scene pair.

claim: Python and Rust initial scene screenshots show identical object colors.
decision: rejected as a pixel-state parity claim
reason: The captures use different live revisions. Python initial captures are revision 4 with the Cube blue; the saved shared fixture is revision 23 with the Cube gold after a later Python MCP edit. Stable IDs, geometry and transforms match.

claim: The first current Release Rust reopen screenshot shows Builder3D.
reason: A different foreground window covered Builder3D during capture. Use the accepted final reopen capture instead.

claim: The first optional-MCP New Scene screenshot demonstrates a successful GUI edit.
reason: The screen-coordinate offset was incorrect and the click missed the New Scene card; the corrected retry is accepted.
